entities.name: Economic Community of Central African States

entities.summary: The Economic Community of Central African States is an Economic Community of the African Union that promotes regional economic co-operation in Central Africa. It "aims to achieve collective autonomy, raise the standard of living of its populations and maintain economic stability through harmonious cooperation".
